title: Normalization of a derived direct-image composition unit
statement:
theorem normalizedDirectImageCompUnit {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ C)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (s ≫ t).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
      (schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso s t).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
    (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s)
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward t)).app K := by sorry

proof.text: Apply the determining equation for the chosen ringed-space comparison. For the component of the generic pasted right-derived unit, represent the homotopy-category object by a complex, simplify the composition-unit formula, and use the identity comparison equation to reduce the comparison inverse to the identity. This identifies the fixed scheme comparison unit with the ringed-space unit equation.
